description: Source code for the HistoryViewModel class managing calculator history items, including loading, adding, deleting, and clearing history entries, with localization and event handling.

classes.name: HistoryViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing the calculator's history list, supporting reload, add, delete, clear, and display operations with localization and event notifications.

methods.name: ReloadHistory
methods.description: Reloads the history list based on the current calculator mode (Standard or Scientific).

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a new history item at a specified index.

methods.name: SetCalculatorDisplay
methods.description: Sets the calculator display callback to update history view.

methods.name: ShowItem
methods.description: Displays a selected history item and logs the event.

methods.name: DeleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a specified history item and updates the UI and localization.

methods.name: OnHideCommand
methods.description: Handles the hide command for the history view.

methods.name: OnClearCommand
methods.description: Clears the entire history list and updates the UI and localization.

methods.name: GetMaxItemSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of history items allowed.
